content.rationale: The failure path is prose answering to prose clauses; a read-through of how the entry surfaces a resolution failure against the refusal, channel, and status clauses is the whole applicable check. Its eleven edges span three cells — five prose parents (natural→natural), three requirement-sentence parents (structured→natural) and three artifact parents (code→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
